checks.detail: Exact pinned initial stopped stage0 manifest, completed stopped restart receipt and existing service-key file are required. Current source is an explicit approved commit; historical file identities join to Git.
All original captured paths must remain; full captured Prisma tree and configuration must remain identical. No initdb, migration, seed, signup or key rotation is selected by resumePlan.

Owned directory device/inode and stopped PG16 metadata are checked. After start a read-only SQL probe joins exact saved database, role, loopback port, data directory and pre-start system identifier before runtime/prompt.

The existing restart-proof.lock is created exclusively with no symlink following; concurrent/replaced claims are refused. Cleanup checks the captured directories/system before signalling the same cluster, checks stopped state, and revalidates source/input bytes. Cleanup failure does not become success.

No credential RNG/file creation is introduced. Existing service keys and DB credentials are used unchanged. Live partner input uses the existing hidden bounded TTY reader; partner enters child environment in memory and is removed from parent runtime environment after spawn. Reports use closed diagnostic fields.

Stage0 sources and provider guard/runtime/transport are unchanged. Resume changes only its in-memory profile to the existing explicit setup-read profile. Diagnostic mode skips owner input, uses the fixed public diagnostic constant and existing sandboxed health-only runtime.

Default invocation is prepared-only. Explicit run requires current committed sources. Builds and own PG start are finite; live runtime is 1–15 minutes after readiness; diagnostic runtime 1 minute; existing prompt bound 600000 ms is retained.

authorReportedChecks.evidenceOrigin: booking_scope message; no rerun by reviewer

qualifications: Static source review and hash checks only. No services, PG, browser, TTY, external network or test execution by reviewer.

The old stage0 receipt contains no historical PG system identifier. The implementation proves identity from the captured pre-start directory/system through this run; it does not invent a historical system-ID receipt.
Application changes require explicit approved commit while canonical schema/migrations stay identical; this is a finite stopped-stage0 transition, not a universal state migration or repair tool.
Live setup-read permits previously approved local A17 effects only after explicit owner actions; no provider-write or complete YCLIENTS acceptance is established here.
Partner is RAM/child-environment only. JavaScript reference clearing does not claim secure memory zeroization or isolation from another process running as the same OS user.
Only this reviewer JSON was written; owner state, private keys and separate live handoff were not inspected.
